personality_one_liner: A highly readable, trustworthy, and organized professional tool with tactile engineering undertones and an earthy botanical palette.

spacing.rule: Use iOS-native comfortable vertical rhythms. Generous padding around content to frame data, not dominate it.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Entry point for owner and employees.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of engineering blueprint with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim. Centered login card (surfaceSecondary, shadow 1, radius lg) containing Email, Password inputs, and a sticky sticky primary CTA. Safe area applied.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Role-based home screen. Owner sees financials; Employees see field tasks.
screens.layout: Modular design. Owner: Top 2-col grid for financial KPI cards (Agreed, Received, Remaining). Below: List of active projects. Employee: 'Today's Field Program' calendar strip on top, followed by a vertical list of assigned tasks. Floating Action Button (FAB) for owner to add new project.

screens.name: ProjectDetail
screens.purpose: Central hub for a single job/project, combining documents, field program, and institution tracking.

states.empty: Empty state for tabs like Documents

screens.layout: Sticky header with project title and glass background. Segmented control (Tabs: Finans, Evraklar, Arazi, Kurum). 'Finans' (Owner only) uses large numbers and progress bars. 'Evraklar' uses a 2-col grid for uploaded files (Tapu, İmar) with upload FAB. 'Kurum' uses an accordion checklist layout for Kadastro, Tapu, Belediye with status indicators (Pending/Approved/Rejected).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) UI logic. The 'Finans' tab and Expense charts must be completely hidden from employee accounts.
For the Owner's financial dashboard, use modular 2-col grids for KPIs (Anlaşan Tutar, Kalan Ödeme) to save vertical space. Use progress rings or horizontal bars to visualize collection status.

Implement the 'Kurum Süreçleri' (Institution Processes) as interactive accordions or checklist items with clear Status Indicators (Pending=Warning color, Approved=Success color, Rejected=Error color).
Document management (Evraklar) must use a structured grid layout for thumbnails/icons (PDF, Tapu, Fotoğraf), ensuring large hit areas (>=44x44pt).
Apply gradient scrims (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) on the login_background image to guarantee text readability.
Use glassmorphism (expo-blur) on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to give it the iOS-Native Clean premium feel.
Ensure all text remains left-aligned or logically grouped. Avoid center alignment for data-heavy sections.
Strictly follow the color palette provided. Use Moss Green (#4A6652) as the primary brand color to reflect the engineering/mapping/land domain. Do not use any blues or purples.
